title: Hazard Tree Removal & Flagstone Patio Rebuild
summary: A declining mesquite in a tiled courtyard was cracking the flagstone patio around it. Rather than patch around the problem, we took the tree down in sections, pulled the stump, tore out the entire damaged patio, and relaid it from scratch.

steps.caption: Rigging the mesquite with tag lines before cutting, to control where each section drops in a tight courtyard.
steps.alt: Crew member rigging a mesquite tree with tag lines before a hazard tree removal in a Las Cruces courtyard

steps.caption: Working from the canopy down, cutting large limbs section by section away from the windows and stucco.
steps.alt: Crew member cutting large tree limbs from the canopy during a hazard tree removal in a Las Cruces courtyard

steps.caption: Reduced to bare branches before the final cuts.
steps.alt: Mesquite tree reduced to bare branches during hazard tree removal in a Las Cruces courtyard

steps.caption: Down to the stump, cut flush with the ground.
steps.alt: Tree stump cut flush to the ground after hazard tree removal on a Las Cruces courtyard patio

steps.caption: With the tree gone, the entire old flagstone patio came out too — broken up and hauled off.
steps.alt: Old flagstone patio demolished into rubble around a fresh-cut tree stump in a Las Cruces courtyard

steps.caption: The root system running under the patio, right at the door — the real reason it needed to come out.
steps.alt: Exposed tree root system running under a demolished flagstone patio near a doorway in Las Cruces

steps.caption: Laser level and string lines mark the new patio before the first stone goes down.
steps.alt: Laser level and string lines laying out a new flagstone patio base in a Las Cruces courtyard

steps.caption: Fresh flagstone delivered by the pallet for the new patio.
steps.alt: Pallet of new flagstone delivered by flatbed truck for a Las Cruces patio rebuild

steps.caption: Setting the first stones by the French doors.
steps.alt: New flagstone being set in mortar near French doors during a Las Cruces patio rebuild

steps.caption: Our stone crew working the joints at the kiva fireplace corner.

steps.caption: A quick look at the flagstone going down.

steps.caption: The finished courtyard — new flagstone throughout, grouted and clean.

steps.caption: And the kiva fireplace corner, with the tree that used to crack it gone for good.
steps.alt: Finished flagstone patio with kiva fireplace at a Las Cruces home
